seo.description: Closing a store or clearing retail space in the GTA? Call +1 647 922 5865!

items.title: Trusted by people of the Greater Toronto Area

c: Clearing out a retail space can be a major undertaking, but Live Junk Free makes it straightforward and efficient. We offer fast, dependable retail cleanout services for store owners, property managers, and commercial landlords throughout the area.

Whether you are rebranding, relocating, or closing your shop, we have got you covered. From display cases and shelving units to unsold inventory and promotional materials, we remove it all. Regardless of your space’s size or condition, our crew arrives prepared, handles all the heavy lifting, and leaves your retail property clean and ready for its next phase.

blocks.text: Retail Cleanouts Made Easy – Fair Prices, Clear Terms

c: Whether it’s a small boutique or a large department store, we ensure your retail cleanout is seamless from start to finish.
Need it cleared soon? We provide same-day and next-day retail cleanouts to meet your timeline, subject to scheduling.

items.q: Do you provide full cleanout services for retail stores?
a: Yes, we offer complete retail cleanout services including fixture removal, inventory clearance, and final cleaning.

items.q: What types of retail fixtures do you remove?
a: We remove all store fixtures, clothing racks, display cases, shelving units, cash wraps, mannequins, and signage.

items.q: How much does a retail cleanout cost?
a: Prices vary based on space size and items removed. We provide free, no-obligation quotes.
